organization.title: Organization name
organization.description: Shown to the user as 'Managed by <name>'.

supportContact.title: Support contact
supportContact.description: E-mail, phone or intranet address shown when a policy blocks an action.

enabled.title: Protection on
enabled.description: true keeps protection always on, false keeps it off. Not set: the user decides.

model.title: Name and address recognition model
model.description: false turns the local model off, for example on computers with little memory. Not set: the user decides.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: auto follows the browser. Not set: the user decides.

dictionary.title: Organization dictionary
dictionary.description: Terms always hidden for every user: client names, projects, internal codes. Added to the personal dictionary, the user cannot remove them.

allowExclusions.title: Allow leaving found data as is
allowExclusions.description: false: the user cannot untick a found value in the panel, every value is always hidden.

allowOriginalFiles.title: Allow sending the original of a file with personal data
allowOriginalFiles.description: false: for PDF and Office files with data found only the clean copy can be sent.

allowUncheckedFiles.title: Allow sending files that cannot be checked
allowUncheckedFiles.description: false: scans, images, password protected and unknown files are not sent.
